note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for cyclic neutropenia.

HPI: (Copied Forward) Patient is a 62-year-old male with a known history of cyclic neutropenia. He reports recurring low neutrophil counts occurring every few weeks. He is currently managed with G-CSF injections. He denies any acute symptoms between cycles.

Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F, Weight 190 lbs.

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Negative
Integumentary: Negative
HEENT: Negative
Respiratory: Negative
Cardiovascular: Negative
Gastrointestinal: Negative
Genitourinary: Negative
Musculoskeletal: Negative
Neurological: Negative

Medication List:
- Filgrastim (G-CSF) subcutaneous injection
- Multivitamin

Exam:
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Skin: No rashes or lesions noted.
Lymphatics: No cervical, axillary, or inguinal lymphadenopathy.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender, no organomegaly.

Assessment:
1. Cyclic neutropenia: Patient remains stable on his current G-CSF regimen. Neutrophil counts continue to fluctuate every few weeks as expected.

Plan:
- Continue current G-CSF dosing schedule.
- Monitor complete blood count (CBC) every 4 weeks to track neutrophil trends.
- Patient to call the office if he notices increased frequency of symptoms between cycles.

Electronically signed,
R. Mensah, NP
